defect: The fix drops the needless tr()/QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP wrapping of QLabel object names (Prev_X etc.) used as findChild keys.
reason: tr() runs in the GamePadDialog context while the names were only marked in the gamepadMapping context, so the lookup keys were returned unchanged and no wrong behaviour resulted; the fix is a cleanup of unnecessary translation.

defect: The new R8G8B8A8_UNORM text path builds pixels as (bAlpha | 0xffffff00), which on little-endian puts the glyph coverage in the red byte and forces alpha to 0xff instead of white with alpha = coverage.
reason: The fix rewrites exactly this added line to (bAlpha << 24) | 0x00ffffff, and the wrong byte placement is evident from the diff.

defect: The added HLSL_D3D11 vsTexCol shader computes mul(float4(pos,1), WorldViewProj), i.e. the transposed matrix, although the D3D11 backend uploads the GL-style column-major matrix raw into a constant buffer.
reason: The fix swaps the operands to mul(WorldViewProj, pos) in this line added by the change; seeing that it is wrong requires the D3D11 uniform upload in thin3d_d3d11.cpp.

defect: The dynamic uniform buffer is created with D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER but the change also creates a shader resource view on it (invalid for a constant buffer) as the way to expose uniforms, so uniforms never reach the vertex shader.
reason: The fix removes the dynamicUniformsView member, creation and release added here and binds the buffer with VSSetConstantBuffers instead; a D3D11 reviewer can see from the diff that a constant buffer cannot be viewed as an SRV.

defect: The new MemCheckAsm compares and passes the raw base register xaddr_ to the memcheck without adding offset_, so register-based memory breakpoints check the wrong address.
reason: The fix subtracts offset_ in the comparisons and adds it before the call, all in the loop this change added; knowing that xaddr_ excludes the offset requires the caller PrepareSlowAccess.

defect: The new MainAudio feeds QAudioOutput from its notify() signal, which the fix replaces with a QObject timer because audio did not work on all platforms.
reason: Whether notify-driven push mode was broken on the platforms supported at the time (Symbian, Meego, Blackberry) or only on Linux/Windows support added a week later cannot be told from the code.

defect: The fix extends AdhocSocket with nonblocking, buffer_size, retry_interval and lastAttempt fields and documents the MallocStat fields.
reason: This is feature work for the Falcom games, not a repair of the connectCount to retry_count/attemptCount rename or the SD_BOTH change made here.

defect: The fix adds the PC to the sceNetGetMallocStat verbose log and changes the faked malloc statistics set in sceNetInit.
reason: The change only lowered a log level; the fix neither reverts nor repairs it.

defect: The fix additionally ignores timed-out peers (last_recv == 0) in sceNetAdhocctlGetNameByAddr and adjusts faked receive times elsewhere.
reason: The isMacMatch comparison introduced here is kept; the new last_recv condition is a behaviour change that was equally absent before this change.

defect: The fix avoids a redundant double bind of the backbuffer in the not-on-top path by binding only when CopyDisplayToOutput is skipped.
reason: The double bind existed before (with DONT_CARE) and the commit says the queue runner already eliminated it, so this is a cleanup, not a defect from switching to CLEAR.

defect: Moving MainAudio into a separate QThread crashes on Symbian, a supported Qt platform.
reason: The fix restricts the thread code added here to non-Symbian builds; the crash is platform-specific runtime behaviour.

defect: HttpImageFileView starts a download whose callback is bound to this, but its destructor does not cancel the download, so a callback after the view is destroyed writes to freed memory.
reason: The fix cancels the download in the destructor and returns early for cancelled downloads in the callback, both in the class this change added.

defect: The fix stretches the Controls dialog background to the client area to fix misalignment under non-default font DPI settings.
reason: The old CImage code also blitted the image at its native size, so the misalignment predates this change.

defect: The fix changes maxSize_ from int to size_t and adds casts to silence type conversion warnings.
reason: Comparing an int buffer size with size_t only produced a warning; no wrong behaviour for realistic sizes.

defect: The fix replaces the per-platform shader directories (Blackberry app/native/assets/shaders, else assets/shaders) with assets/shaders on Android and VFS-relative shaders elsewhere, together with a native submodule update.
reason: The Blackberry path matched the bar-descriptor packaging and glsl_create reads local files first, so it worked when written; the fix adapts paths to later asset handling.

defect: The added vai_.Clear() in DestroyDeviceObjects drops the owned VertexArrayInfoVulkan pointers without deleting them, leaking them on every device loss.
reason: The fix deletes each entry before clearing, repairing the line this change added; that vai_ owns raw pointers is declared in the header.

defect: The fix removes the separate Comp_Vsge/Comp_Vslt DISABLE stubs and adds (still disabled) vsge/vslt code to the shared VecDo3 path.
reason: The stubs only fell back to the interpreter, which is correct; the fix is a feature attempt and refactor.

defect: The fix restructures Comp_VecDo3 from a member-function pointer to per-op switches and adds disabled vsge/vslt and vmin/vmax handling.
reason: This is feature work and refactoring 176 days later on a function that was itself DISABLEd when added; it does not repair a defect in the change's lines.

defect: The fix moves the bvfbs_, knownFramebufferCopies_ and PBO members to the end of FramebufferManager to silence member-initialization-order warnings.
reason: Reordering declarations to fix -Wreorder warnings is a style fix, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix splits the OSD message into ShowScreenResolution and makes SetInternalResolution call gpu->Resized directly so in-game resolution changes apply.
reason: This change preserved each caller's noWindowMovement semantics and gpu->Resized() was still unconditional; the resolution bug came from later ResizeDisplay edits (Jan/Feb 2014).

defect: The fix raises the shader compile failure log from INFO to WARN and adds a log for vkCreateShaderModule failure.
reason: Only logging changes; nothing in the change was wrong.

defect: The fix simplifies the Adreno logic-test Vulkan shaders to a minimal repro of the driver bug.
reason: Adjusting a driver test shader is a test change, not a repair of a defect in the emulator.

defect: Converting stencil_ps to a raw string left the STR(CONST_PS_STENCILVALUE) concatenation inside the literal, so the shader text contains register(c" STR(CONST_PS_STENCILVALUE) ") and fails to compile.
reason: The fix closes and reopens the raw string around the macro in exactly this changed line, and the mistake is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix moves Clear() before counting the save names because Clear() was resetting the shared count.
reason: Here the count is a local variable and Clear() uses the previous saveNameListDataCount, so calling it after counting was correct; the reset came with the later savestate refactor that made the count a member.

defect: The fix adapts the UWP build to later API changes (System_GetPropertyBool, VulkanMayBeAvailable, removed BindBackbufferAsRenderTarget).
reason: The build break comes from interface changes made after this commit, not from its lines.

defect: The fix calls InitDeviceObjects instead of DeviceRestore in the constructor to stop leaking pipelines, and removes the now unused allocator.
reason: At this commit DeviceRestore only set up the allocator and called InitDeviceObjects once; the leak arose after presentation_->DeviceRestore was added (May 9-10) and the allocator became unused after MakePixelTexture moved.

defect: The fix sets the out-of-range EP id error codes to ERROR_PSMF_NOT_FOUND (and invalid psmf to NOT_INITIALIZED) and adds a Kurohyou 2 stack workaround.
reason: The code returned a guessed wrong error (INVALID_TIMESTAMP) before this change; replacing one guess with another did not introduce the defect.

defect: The fix initializes bool res = true to silence a maybe-uninitialized warning.
reason: The switch covers every GEComparison value the color and alpha test functions can produce, so res was always assigned; this is a warning fix.

defect: For pre-v6 savestates the change reads the old stats block into the new gpuStats layout and skips two ints at the end, but the removed fields sat before numVBlanks, so numVBlanks, numFlips and the later counters are loaded from the wrong fields.
reason: The fix replaces the ignore-trailing-ints hack added here with reading a GPUStatistics_v0 struct of the old layout; finding where the fields were removed requires GPU.h history.

defect: The fix rewrites receiving from send threads and from the pipe buffer (read offsets, queueing, rescheduling) in __KernelReceiveMsgPipe and the send path.
reason: The repaired data-transfer logic predates this change, which only added argument checks and replaced m->GetUID() with a local uid.

defect: The new ins path for an immediate rs maps rt with gpr.MapReg(rt) without MAP_DIRTY before modifying it, so the inserted bits are never written back.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added call to MapReg(rt, MAP_DIRTY); the other paths in the diff use MapDirtyIn, which makes the omission visible.

defect: Streams are created with channel currentVideoStreamNum/currentAudioStreamNum before incrementing, and those counters start at -1, so the first video and audio streams get channel -1.
reason: The fix uses pre-increment in exactly these lines; the -1 initialisation is visible a few lines above in the diff.

defect: The fix decodes fully loaded tracks from buffer + curOff instead of buffer + streamOff.
reason: Here streamOff advanced in lockstep with curOff for every state; the break came from 1dd48ec, which stopped advancing streamOff for non-streaming states.

defect: The fix changes the restart method to take an argument string, restart:(const char *)args.
reason: This is an interface extension for the Vulkan-to-GL switch, not the repair of a defect.

defect: UnsyncKey computes retval from UnsyncKeyEvent but always returns true, so keys like volume are reported as consumed by the UI.
reason: The fix returns retval in exactly this added function; the unused retval is visible in the diff.

defect: The added printf(_t_, __VA_ARGS__) in _dbg_assert_msg_ passes the log-type token (e.g. CPU) as printf's format argument, which breaks debug builds.
reason: The fix changes it to printf(__VA_ARGS__) in exactly this added line.

defect: The fix casts audioList.size() to int for the %d in the debug log.
reason: The %d with a size_t argument was already there; the change only reworded the message, and the fix silences a format warning.

defect: The fix corrects printf formats (%lli/%llx for the 64-bit positions, an extra %i) in sceAacInit logs.
reason: The same mismatched formats existed in the AACCtx code before; the change only renamed fields.

defect: The fix declares ssLoadStoreTemp as a scalar u32 instead of a one-element array.
reason: Both &ssLoadStoreTemp and ssLoadStoreTemp yield the same address for the array, so the emitted code was correct; this is a type cleanup.

defect: The fix declares ssLoadStoreTemp as a scalar u32 instead of a one-element array.
reason: Taking &ssLoadStoreTemp of the one-element array gives the same address the code needs, so behaviour was unaffected; the fix is a type cleanup.
